newsitem.title: USA: Falcon Products sees higher Q4, year revs.
newsitem.headline: Falcon Products sees higher Q4, year revs.

text.p: Falcon Products Inc said on Wednesday it expects to report that revenues for the fourth quarter ended November 2 rose to about $32.2 million from $26.7 million a year earlier.

The company also said it will report to finanial analysts later this week at meetings in New York that revenues for fiscal year 1996 were about $110.0 million, up 23.3 percent from the $90 million in revenues posted in fiscal 1995.
The company also said its backlog of unfilled orders believed to be firm was about $17.7 million at November 2, 1996 compared with $10.5 million a year earlier.
The 1996 backlog includes about $2.7 million related to The Chair Source, a business it acquired on October 28, 1996.
Falcon manufactures and markets products for the hospitality and lodging, foodserice and office furniture industries.
The company said it will report actual revenues and earnings results in about six weeks.
